content: Netflix Eureka is in maintenance mode (no new features since Spring Cloud Greenwich); still works and ships in current Spring Cloud release trains but is not actively evolved. HashiCorp Consul is the most common modern alternative, and Kubernetes-native service discovery is preferred in cloud-native setups. For docker-compose-only portfolio projects, Docker's built-in DNS-based service discovery (service name as hostname) removes the need for Eureka/Consul entirely.
